issue.title: Restore SDD validation after prompt-archive migration
issue.description: Running just check in a clean sase workspace on 2026-08-02 reaches sase validate and fails plan links validate with 5,764 errors and 519 warnings. The errors are dominated by legacy prompt Markdown still present under monthly plans-store prompts/ directories (prompt-in-plans-store) and plan 'prompt' links whose targets no longer exist after canonical agents-sidecar archival (link-missing-target). Restore a clean validation baseline by migrating or reconciling the historical prompt documents and links, then verify sase validate and just check pass. This failure is independent of the prompt_archive/publish.py module split; all code lint gates and focused prompt archive tests pass.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction from rn while implementing durable gate-backed statistics: after opening the clean plans sidecar, just check passed formatting and all lint gates, then sase validate failed plan links with the same 5,764 errors and 519 warnings (prompt-in-plans-store plus link-missing-target). This blocks the required repository-wide check but is unrelated to the stats changes.

payload.close_reason: No longer reproducible on master 5143cb981: sase validate passes all five checks and sase plan links validate reports 3406 files with 0 errors (522 warnings), against the reported 5,764 errors / 519 warnings. The plans sidecar no longer contains 202607/prompts/, and 404fac3b5 fixed the validator unavailable-prompt-archive handling. This supersedes the 2026-08-02T11:13Z +1 from rn.

evidence.note: Recurrence in a second project's plans store, found during the sase-ez epic land audit on 2026-08-03. Phases sase-ez.4 and sase-ez.5 both independently reported that 'sase validate' run from a bob-cli workspace fails 'plan links validate' with 57 prompt-in-plans-store errors: legacy prompt Markdown still living under monthly plans-store prompts/ directories in the gh_bobs-org__bob-cli plans sidecar. This is the same defect and the same remediation as the original sase report (migrate or reconcile the historical prompt documents so validate returns to a clean baseline), so the fix should cover every project's plans store rather than only sase's. It is independent of the bob-cli bead-ID reprefix that sase-ez.4 performed: the reprefix token audit is clean and these errors name prompt documents, not bead IDs.
